description: Sewer Abandoned Lines is a dataset listed in Pierce County open data portal (internal.open.piercecountywa.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a region, state, county or agency, published or maintained by Pierce County. This data identifies the approximate location of Public sewer lines that have been abandoned in place. This data does not depict all Public sewer lines that have been abandoned. Sewer as-builts must be reviewed. This data is updated as needed. Coverage: Pierce County, Washington. The portal files it under the category Maps and Geospatial. Its tags are sewer line, sewer, abandoned. The table has 11 columns. The portal shows 2025-01-31 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support wastewater and sewer network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-internal-open-piercecountywa-gov-portal.
